en: Sepia-toned historic view of a European market square with cobblestone paving. Lined with two- and three‑story townhouses and shops, the square is dominated by two church towers in the background—one a tall Gothic spire with clock faces, the other a shorter tower with a dome and clock. A lattice metal pole with multiple crossarms for telegraph or electrical lines stands prominently in the foreground. Pedestrians, including a man in a suit and several women and children with a pram, are scattered around the square. The printed caption at the top left reads "Wilsdruff — Markt," and several shop signs are visible on the right-hand buildings.
